movie.field: upper-left dividing cell in Movie S3

asymmetry.observable: Mean absolute difference between the two daughters' visible focus counts, grouped by their sum at division.
asymmetry.precision: Means and SEMs read from the published graph. Cohort sizes are printed labels.
asymmetry.reference: For n intact independent units and a common first-daughter probability p, the prediction is the binomial mean of |2k - n| over k.

scope: These cytoplasmic aggregates can fuse and their motion is spatially constrained. A visible focus can contain multiple proteins. Daughter membrane areas paired with these counts were unavailable.
